page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance is equipped with a single NVIDIA P4 GPU providing 8 GB of dedicated VRAM.

This server type does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile represents an entry-level GPU-accelerated configuration. The combination of dedicated vCPUs, a moderate memory allocation, and a dedicated NVIDIA P4 GPU makes this instance suitable for workloads such as lightweight machine learning inference, video transcoding, and basic parallel processing tasks that benefit from GPU acceleration without requiring high-end accelerator hardware or high-speed local storage.

This entry-level GPU configuration is designed for workloads requiring moderate parallel computing capabilities, such as lightweight machine learning inference, video encoding, and basic graphics rendering, where high-end GPU resources are not qualitatively cost-effective.
